description: The columns of rows a SQL function returns whose value MEOS does not state. parser/sqlfn.py feeds every column of a returned row from the C value of its type: the value or array the function returns, or an out-parameter. A column its wrapper computes rather than reads is declared here, keyed by the composite type the function returns, or by its SQL name when it returns record; a row with a column neither fed nor declared stops the catalog.

geomval.note: PostGIS's composite of a geometry and a value, created by postgis_raster, which MobilityDB requires when built with RASTER; dumpAsPolygons returns a set of them.

dumpValues.note: raster_dump_values answers the values of a band row by row and, in nodata, true for a nodata pixel; its wrapper answers them as a height by width array, NULL for a nodata pixel, as PostGIS's ST_DumpValues does, each row raster_width of the raster long.

setValues.note: Raster_set_values reads its values, a one- or two-dimensional array, row by row into the values of raster_set_values, true in nodata for a NULL element, its rows and columns the height and width of the block, as PostGIS's ST_SetValues does; it reads its flags, an array of their own size, into noset, a NULL flag false.

geomval.note: A GeomVal holds a polygon and the value of the pixels it covers; the rows of geomval read its geom and its val, as PostGIS's ST_DumpAsPolygons does.

index_tbox.note: The tiles of a temporal box: index numbers them from 1 in the order the MEOS array returns them.

index_stbox.note: The tiles of a spatiotemporal box: index numbers them from 1 in the order the MEOS array returns them.

aDisjointPairs.note: i and j are positions in the SQL arrays, from 1; MEOS returns the C indices, from 0.

aDwithinPairs.note: i and j are positions in the SQL arrays, from 1; MEOS returns the C indices, from 0.

jsonbEachText.note: The key and the value are both text: the key is the array jsonb_each_text returns, the value its out-parameter values.

valueCount.note: A ValueCount holds the count and the percent of a value; the rows of valueCount read its value and its count, as PostGIS's ST_ValueCount does.

valuePercent.note: A ValueCount holds the count and the percent of a value; the rows of valuePercent read its value and its percent, as PostGIS's ST_ValuePercent does.

pixelAsPoints.note: A Pixel holds its column, its row, whether it is nodata, its value and its point; the rows of pixelAsPoints read its point, its value, its column and its row, as PostGIS's ST_PixelAsPoints does.

geoPoseFrames.note: A GeoPoseFrame holds the fields of one row of the geopose_frames table, each read by the column of its name.
